captures.note: extensions is a kept profile whose storage root's path names nothing personal, since the cards' details show it. It holds four packages - Continuum Subtraction, GAIA Glow Subtraction, HDR Multiscale and Narrowband Normalization - and a local repository, each environment prepared, so that the Installed tab counts them all available. An environment is prepared for one build of AfterNight: after a new build each card reads Repair Needed until its Repair Environment is pressed, or the package launched, once. The first card in the tab's order is opened on its details. The page's pins follow this picture.
